create_stream_producer_consumer: create a StreamProducer and StreamConsumer to pass data between Labgraph nodes via shared memory
use_clock_manager: use the clockManager to synchronize timing across Labgraph graph nodes
register_stream_types: register a new StreamDescription with the streamRegistry for custom data types
manage_memory_pool: manage the memoryPool to allocate and free CpuBuffer or GpuBuffer instances
inspect_type_registry: inspect the typeRegistry to list all registered TypeDefinition and TypeInfo entries
